This is a visual mockup, layout text will be implemented separately in code.

assets.name: huangzhong-sheet
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game sprite sheet. Create exactly EIGHT separate full-body sprites of one original Three Kingdoms veteran archer Huang Zhong, in an evenly spaced FOUR columns by TWO rows grid on genuine transparent RGBA background. High-detail hand-authored pixel-art rendering, crisp small pixel clusters, 3/4 view facing right, mature FC/SFC-era commercial RPG aesthetic. Old Chinese male, flowing WHITE beard and white eyebrows, GOLDEN OCHRE lamellar armor, burgundy short mantle, bronze helmet with narrow red crest, tall elegant curved Chinese war bow and back quiver. Same proportions and identity all eight sprites. Row1 left-right: idle calm with bow held upright, second idle bow tilted and breathing, anticipation drawing arrow back with deep grounded stance, strike released arrow while bow extended diagonally. Row2 left-right: recover lowering bow, hurt recoiling with white beard tossed, cast raising one hand and bow for rally, KO collapsed sideways still fully visible. Each figure plus entire bow and arrow fully inside own cell, generous transparent gutters; each pose one connected large silhouette by touching bow/hand/body; no separate flying arrows. No ground shadows, text, labels, gridlines, scenery or checkerboard. Single sheet landscape 1536x1024. Do not copy protected commercial sprites. Preserve actual transparency.

assets.name: changsha-background
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production portrait battlefield background for mobile five-row five-versus-five pixel RPG. Tall 1024x1536 image. Ancient southern Chinese fortified Changsha city gate at warm autumn sunset, red-roofed grey stone watchtower and walls occupy ONLY top 20 percent, ochre hazy mountains, two small gold-leaved trees at extreme edges, torch baskets and distant grain wagons near gate. Entire lower 75 percent is a broad EMPTY flat stone-and-earth parade courtyard with subtle worn paving slabs and fine dust, three-quarter slightly elevated perspective, consistent daylight and grounded plane for ten figures arranged in five rows. Keep both combatant columns empty all the way from 25 to 95 percent height. No people, characters, animals, vehicles in foreground, no large obstructions, no text/banners/logos/watermarks. Fine crisp hand-authored pixel art texture, high-detail mature FC/SFC-era original commercial RPG background, no gradient vector or photo, restrained contrast so sprites remain clearly legible.
